role.altitude: The week keeps the client visit, the check of the written advice, and the send. Less time goes to copying passages that are already in the brief and the course notes. The teacher gains no right to send advice they have not accepted, and no right to skip the visit.
skills_to_grow: Keep course notes under the headings the copy reads.
Refuse a send when the accepted advice is missing or was edited later.
Leave the curriculum judgement in the visit, not in the copied passages.
role.ambitious_version: An instructional coordinator could use the same accept-then-send pattern for a curriculum note a school asked for, and would still accept that note before it left.

tasks.short: Provide consulting services to government or industry.

steps.what: Read the consulting request from government or industry
Read the curriculum or policy brief attached
Read own psychology course methods for the advice
Advise government or industry on the curriculum in person
Draft professional consulting advice from brief and notes
Check drafted consulting advice against the visit
Provide accepted consulting services by mail

tasks.design: The client brief in {DOCS} and the teacher's own course notes in the {LMS} already hold the passages a note can quote. A copy places those passages under the advice headings and stops. The teacher advises the client in person, checks that the draft still matches that visit, and only then sends the accepted note from {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice depends on this client's curriculum or policy and on what the teacher will say in the room. A tool that wrote the opinion would send advice the teacher had not given.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief and the course notes are text the teacher already has. Copying sentences that sit under headings is ordinary configuration. The visit and the acceptance stay with the teacher.
tasks.still_hard: Judging what this government or industry client should change, and saying it in the room. The copy cannot do that.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher decides the advice and stands behind it with the client. A copied passage is not that decision.
tasks.altitude: Less time goes to copying passages already in the brief and the course notes. The visit, the meaning check, and the send take the same time. The teacher gains no right to send unaccepted advice and no right to skip the visit.

reach.task: Prepare a curriculum note a school asked for.
reach.learn: Copy only sentences the brief and the course notes already contain, and accept the note before it is sent.

evidence.claim: Sentences already written under headings in a client brief and in course notes can be copied into an advice draft and held until a person accepts them.
Annex III point 3 covers admission, evaluation of learning outcomes, setting an education level, and detecting cheating in tests.

assumptions: Published means sum to 100.0. Floors are 4, 3, 14, 36 and 41, which add to 98. The two extras go to mail (remainder 0.8) and then spreadsheets (remainder 0.5), giving 4, 4, 15, 36 and 41.
This consulting task does not keep a workbook. The 4 spreadsheet points move onto documents, so the shares used are screens 4, spreadsheets 0, mail 15, documents 40 and meetings 41.
The screen share is a read of the course methods the advice will quote. It is not an open-by-id step and not a dashboard.

The copy reads two fields only: a heading and the sentences already under that heading. The producers are the client brief in {DOCS} and the course notes in the {LMS}. A heading with no sentences is skipped. The teacher writes that passage in the check, which stays at full time.
The actor on every step is the psychology teacher, including the copy. That person reads, visits, checks and sends today. The machine appears only as the future fate of the copy.
The visit is the consulting service. It does not hand over the note. The only release is the later mail, and that mail is gated on accepted consulting advice v1. A later edit voids the check.
The copy does not judge the advice. Advising stays with the teacher, so there is no model loop.

The note is not a grade, an admission, an education-level decision, or a cheating finding, so the annex III education duties are not opened. The copy does not observe staff, so no works-council monitoring consent is opened.
No focal upkeep row is included. The heading list is system upkeep and does not reduce the teacher's net. Exception time sits in the check, which remains at 100.
All shares are focal. Central net is 12, the copy step only. The range low is a brief with no headings, so nothing is copied. The range high leaves the visit, the check and the send at full time.
unknowns: Whether every consulting visit at this institution ends with a written note.
Whether client briefs use headings a copy can read.
Whether someone besides the teacher must accept the note before it is sent.
Whether the course methods live in the {LMS} or only in {DOCS}.
research_questions: How often is a written note sent after the visit?
Which headings does a typical government or industry brief use?
Does a head of department have to accept the note before it leaves?

already_counted.description: The teacher reads the draft and decides whether it matches the advice given in the visit. That time stays in the check.

incremental.description: A system keeps the heading list the copy reads when a consulting brief arrives.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a brief with no headings, so nothing is copied and the teacher writes the note while checking it. High is a brief and course notes that already hold most of the quoted passages, while the visit, the check and the send stay at full time. Central net is the 12-point copy only.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
